name: Refrigerator Chess
author: alexh@isyourrefrigerator.online
description: Full-stack real-time chess platform with Stockfish 16.1 AVX2 engine, PvP invite match system, PvE boss bot progression, and tactical puzzles.
startup: git config --global --add safe.directory "*" 2>/dev/null || true; if [ ! -d ".git" ]; then echo "[Startup] Initializing repository from ${GIT_ADDRESS:-https://github.com/Trollmeneerr/Chess.git}..." && git init && git remote add origin "${GIT_ADDRESS:-https://github.com/Trollmeneerr/Chess.git}" && git fetch origin main && git reset --hard origin/main && npm install --production --no-audit; elif [ "${AUTO_UPDATE:-true}" = "true" ] || [ "${AUTO_UPDATE:-true}" = "1" ]; then echo "[Startup] Syncing latest updates from GitHub..." && (git fetch origin main && git reset --hard origin/main) 2>/dev/null || echo "[Startup] Git fetch skipped or offline, booting local files."; fi; chmod +x engine/stockfish 2>/dev/null || true; if [ ! -d "node_modules" ]; then npm install --production --no-audit; fi; node src/server.js --port {{SERVER_PORT}} --domain {{SUBDOMAIN}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Refrigerator Chess Pelican Egg Installation Script
# Target Container: node:20-bookworm-slim
set -e

echo "=== [1/4] Installing git, build essentials, and tools ==="
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git curl ca-certificates tar stockfish build-essential python3 || true

cd /mnt/server

echo "=== [2/4] Fetching application repository ==="
git config --global --add safe.directory "*" 2>/dev/null || true
TARGET_GIT="${GIT_ADDRESS:-https://github.com/Trollmeneerr/Chess.git}"

if [ -d ".git" ]; then
    echo "Repository already exists, syncing updates..."
    git remote set-url origin "$TARGET_GIT" 2>/dev/null || git remote add origin "$TARGET_GIT" 2>/dev/null || true
    git fetch origin main
    git reset --hard origin/main
else
    echo "Initializing repository from ${TARGET_GIT}..."
    git init
    git remote add origin "$TARGET_GIT" 2>/dev/null || git remote set-url origin "$TARGET_GIT" 2>/dev/null || true
    git fetch origin main
    git reset --hard origin/main
fi

echo "=== [3/4] Installing Stockfish Engine ==="
mkdir -p /mnt/server/engine
if [ -f "/usr/games/stockfish" ]; then
    cp /usr/games/stockfish /mnt/server/engine/stockfish
    chmod +x /mnt/server/engine/stockfish
    echo "✓ Stockfish package binary installed to /mnt/server/engine/stockfish"
elif [ ! -f "/mnt/server/engine/stockfish" ] || [ ! -x "/mnt/server/engine/stockfish" ]; then
    mkdir -p /tmp/sf_extract
    SF_URL="https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/releases/download/sf_16.1/stockfish-ubuntu-x86-64-sse41-popcnt.tar"
    if curl -sL --fail --connect-timeout 15 "$SF_URL" -o /tmp/sf_download.tar; then
        tar -xf /tmp/sf_download.tar -C /tmp/sf_extract
        SF_BIN=$(find /tmp/sf_extract -type f ! -name "*.tar" ! -name "*.gz" | head -n 1)
        if [ -n "$SF_BIN" ]; then
            mv "$SF_BIN" /mnt/server/engine/stockfish
            chmod +x /mnt/server/engine/stockfish
            echo "✓ Stockfish release binary installed at /mnt/server/engine/stockfish"
        fi
        rm -rf /tmp/sf_*
    else
        echo "Notice: Could not fetch Stockfish release archive. Built-in simulation fallback will be active."
    fi
fi

echo "=== [4/4] Installing Node.js dependencies ==="
if [ -f "package.json" ]; then
    npm install --production --no-audit
fi

echo "=== Setting proper container file ownership ==="
chown -R 988:988 /mnt/server 2>/dev/null || chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/server 2>/dev/null || true

echo "=== Refrigerator Chess installation finished successfully ==="

variables.name: Custom Subdomain
variables.description: The subdomain domain name used for generating invite links, CORS origin validation, and WebSocket origin headers.

variables.name: Stockfish Max Depth
variables.description: Hard search cap for Stockfish engine evaluations (Strictly enforced at 8 as per specification to prevent CPU bottlenecking).

variables.name: Stockfish Hash Memory (MB)
variables.description: Memory allocation in megabytes for the Stockfish transposition hash table.

variables.name: Stockfish CPU Threads
variables.description: Number of CPU threads allocated to the Stockfish engine process.

variables.name: Database Host
variables.description: Pelican Panel Database Host IP or hostname (e.g. 172.18.0.1). Leave empty to use local SQLite fallback.

variables.name: Database Name
variables.description: MySQL/MariaDB database name provisioned from Pelican Panel's Database tab.

variables.name: Database Username
variables.description: MySQL/MariaDB username provisioned from Pelican Panel.

variables.name: Database Password
variables.description: MySQL/MariaDB password provisioned from Pelican Panel.

variables.name: Puzzle ELO Reward
variables.description: Rating points awarded to user upon solving a tactical puzzle without using the solution hint.

variables.name: Bot Low ELO Reward
variables.description: Base rating points awarded for defeating a bot lower than or equal to player rating.

variables.name: Git Repository Address
variables.description: Git repository URL to clone during egg installation.

variables.name: Auto Update on Startup
variables.description: Automatically check for git repository updates and database migrations every time the server starts.
